metadata.description: Security-audit skills for codebases, smart contracts and Circom ZK circuits, plus Trail of Bits' plugins (CC BY-SA 4.0)

plugins.name: security-auditor
plugins.description: Best-of audit skill combining Cloudflare's workflow, Pashov's attacker lenses and judging, and Trail of Bits' verification, variant, diff and platform methods, for codebases, smart contracts, other chains and ZK circuits

plugins.name: auditor-zk-skills
plugins.description: security-auditor (best-of combined), unified-security-audit (Cloudflare workflow + Pashov Solidity agents, x-ray, fizz) and circom-auditor

plugins.name: krait
plugins.description: Zealynx Krait checklist: quick scans, full framework assessments and single-check deep dives against 845 checks across 39 DeFi verticals (/krait:scan, /krait:assess, /krait:check)

plugins.name: audit-context-building
plugins.description: Understand a codebase before looking for bugs in it. Reads it function by function, records what each one assumes and depends on, and saves the write-ups to files instead of filling up the conversation.

plugins.name: building-secure-contracts
plugins.description: Comprehensive smart contract security toolkit based on Trail of Bits' Building Secure Contracts framework. Includes vulnerability scanners for 6 blockchains and 5 development guideline assistants.

plugins.name: burpsuite-project-parser
plugins.description: Search and extract data from Burp Suite project files (.burp) for security analysis

plugins.name: chrome-mcp-troubleshooting
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix Claude in Chrome MCP extension connectivity issues

plugins.name: constant-time-analysis
plugins.description: Detect compiler-induced timing side-channels in cryptographic code

plugins.name: culture-index
plugins.description: Interprets Culture Index survey results for individuals and teams

plugins.name: devcontainer-setup
plugins.description: Create pre-configured devcontainers with Claude Code and language-specific tooling

plugins.name: differential-review
plugins.description: Security-focused differential review of code changes with git history analysis and blast radius estimation

plugins.name: firebase-apk-scanner
plugins.description: Scan Android APKs for Firebase security misconfigurations including open databases, storage buckets, authentication issues, and exposed cloud functions. For authorized security research only.

plugins.name: gh-cli
plugins.description: Intercepts GitHub URL fetches (WebFetch and MCP fetch tools) and curl/wget commands, redirecting to the authenticated gh CLI.

plugins.name: dwarf-expert
plugins.description: Analyze DWARF debug information: parse and search DIEs with dwarfdump and readelf, verify debug info integrity, and write DWARF parsing code

plugins.name: entry-point-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyzes smart contract codebases to identify state-changing entry points for security auditing. Detects externally callable functions that modify state, categorizes them by access level, and generates structured audit reports.

plugins.name: mutation-testing
plugins.description: Configures mewt or muton campaigns, analyzes surviving mutants, and investigates bugs exposed by testing gaps. Use when setting up mutation testing, reviewing campaign results, identifying equivalent mutants, or finding bugs from surviving mutations.

plugins.name: patching-bugs
plugins.description: Agent-orchestrated workflow to reproduce, patch, prove and regression-check one known bug.

plugins.name: post-patch-validation
plugins.description: Validates security patches against the reported bug, root-cause variants, and surrounding behavior. Returns reproducible failures to repair and validation gaps, with pinned inputs and saved evidence. Bundles a validate-patch dynamic workflow for Claude Code.

plugins.name: property-based-testing
plugins.description: Write, review, and triage property-based tests — Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, and Echidna or Medusa for Solidity invariants

plugins.name: regression-hunt
plugins.description: Agent-orchestrated skills for finding, reproducing and adjudicating regressions in PRs or commits.

plugins.name: semgrep-rule-creator
plugins.description: Create custom Semgrep rules for detecting bug patterns and security vulnerabilities

plugins.name: semgrep-rule-variant-creator
plugins.description: Creates language variants of existing Semgrep rules with proper applicability analysis and test-driven validation

plugins.name: sharp-edges
plugins.description: Identify error-prone APIs, dangerous configurations, and footgun designs that enable security mistakes

plugins.name: static-analysis
plugins.description: Static analysis toolkit with CodeQL, Semgrep, and SARIF parsing for security vulnerability detection

plugins.name: spec-to-code-compliance
plugins.description: Check code against the documentation that specifies it: one agent per requirement, divergences refuted before they are reported, evidence cited to the line

plugins.name: testing-handbook-skills
plugins.description: Skills from the Trail of Bits Application Security Testing Handbook (appsec.guide)

plugins.name: trailmark
plugins.description: Builds source and binary code graphs for security analysis, context slicing, mutation testing, cryptographic protocol modeling, finding triage, and variant analysis.

plugins.name: variant-analysis
plugins.description: Find similar vulnerabilities and bugs across codebases using pattern-based analysis

plugins.name: c-review
plugins.description: Comprehensive C/C++ security code review, with coverage verified against a parse of the source

plugins.name: rust-review
plugins.description: Comprehensive Rust security code review with specialized bug-finding agents covering the safe/unsafe boundary, memory safety in unsafe blocks, concurrency, panic-induced DoS, recursion-induced stack overflow, FFI, and async runtime hazards

author.name: Andrea Cappa (Aptos Labs) & Paweł Płatek (Trail of Bits)

plugins.name: modern-python
plugins.description: Modern Python best practices. Use when creating new Python projects, and writing Python scripts, or migrating existing projects from legacy tools.

plugins.name: insecure-defaults
plugins.description: Detects insecure default configurations including hardcoded credentials, fallback secrets, weak authentication defaults, and dangerous values in production

plugins.name: review-walkthrough
plugins.description: Generates an interactive HTML walkthrough for reviewing code changes. Use only when explicitly called.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Gets independent code reviews from Codex or Antigravity for uncommitted changes, branch diffs, and commits.

plugins.name: yara-authoring
plugins.description: YARA-X detection rule authoring with linting and quality analysis

plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Safely analyzes and cleans up local git branches and worktrees by categorizing them as merged, squash-merged, superseded, or active work.

plugins.name: goal-prompt
plugins.description: Drafts copy-ready /goal commands for goal mode in Claude Code and Codex: verifiable completion conditions with stop bounds, normalized to a single line under the 4,000-character cap.

plugins.name: supply-chain-risk-auditor
plugins.description: Audit a project's npm, PyPI, and Go dependencies for supply-chain risk: version-matched advisories for direct dependencies and the full lockfile tree, abandoned upstreams, npm publisher concentration, and install scripts

plugins.name: zeroize-audit
plugins.description: Detects missing or compiler-optimized zeroization of sensitive data with assembly and control-flow analysis

plugins.name: let-fate-decide
plugins.description: Draws the 12 Houses of the Zodiac Tarot spread using cryptographic randomness to add 100+ bits of entropy to vague or underspecified planning. Interprets the spread to guide next steps. Use when feeling lucky, invoking heart-of-the-cards energy, or when prompts are ambiguous.

plugins.name: agentic-actions-auditor
plugins.description: Audits GitHub Actions workflows for security vulnerabilities in AI agent integrations (Claude Code Action, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, GitHub AI Inference)

plugins.name: code-improver
plugins.description: Improves code targets — skills, plugins, or a branch's changes — through an autonomous review-and-fix workflow with a pluggable reviewer (any installed skill or agent), a cross-round findings ledger, oscillation escalation, and a mechanical scope guard.

plugins.name: fp-check
plugins.description: Systematic false positive verification for security bug analysis with mandatory gate reviews

plugins.name: dimensional-analysis
plugins.description: Audits code for unit and decimal-scaling bugs and annotates it with dimensional comments recording the units of each value. Use when someone asks to audit or review code for unit confusion, decimals or scaling mismatches, WAD/RAY scale errors, or the wrong token's decimals; to annotate units in a codebase; or to perform a dimensional analysis of a DeFi protocol, offchain code, or other arithmetic-heavy codebase. Catches formulas that combine values carrying different units or scales.

plugins.name: vulnerability-triage-brocards
plugins.description: Principled framework for triaging vulnerability reports using 7 brocards (rules of thumb). Evaluates incoming CVEs, bug bounty submissions, and security findings against structured dismissal/acceptance criteria before escalating to deeper analysis.

plugins.name: github-triage
plugins.description: Triages a repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests via the gh CLI: optionally merges ready bot and maintainer-approved PRs and spawns review subagents for unreviewed ones, closes already-resolved issues with referenced explanations, cross-links issues with pending fix PRs, and assigns local-only priority and change-size estimates.

plugins.name: open-sourcing
plugins.description: Prepares a repository for public open-source release: secrets-history hygiene, license selection, documentation and CI readiness checks, and language-specific packaging and release guidance.

plugins.name: writing-lean-proofs
plugins.description: Structured Lean 4 proof writing and library design following Mathlib conventions

plugins.name: modern-cpp
plugins.description: Modern C++ best practices (C++20/23/26). Use when writing C++ code, creating new C++ projects, or modernizing legacy C++ patterns.
